title: Reprint · The Fourth, 2001
logline: The papers run the 2001 Fourth re-inked: the dock, the fireworks, the uncle's chair five months empty. The 2010 hand draws the chair with a steadiness the 2001 hand didn't have and the fireworks with less. The book runs it beside the original.

margin.note: A second, smaller date under the gull: 2001.

panels.composition: The dock at night, fireworks as white bursts, GULLY and WOOD on the planks, the uncle's chair empty beside Gully — the chair's lines steady, the bursts fewer.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, two young men on a dock at night under a few white firework bursts beside an empty lawn chair drawn with steady lines, gray wash
image.notes: A reprint: the 2001 Fourth (dw_2001-07-04) in the 2010 hand.

panels.composition: WOOD looking at the chair, not up.

panels.composition: The chair, the dog under it, the bursts in the water — the water drawn best of all.

notes: Reprint pair, the Fourth 2001. The chair steady; the fireworks fewer.
